lessons.rule: Do not treat HTTP 200 as proof of successful numerical extraction.
An 'empty' wrapper containing HEAD/DATA can be valid; a blank message is not numeric data.
Check Argument and table-specific TABLE_TYPE before interpreting response.
Verify exact load-case suffix and node/element selection against independently verified model metadata.
Construction-stage results may need OPT_CS true and appropriate STAGE_STEP; do not guess stage names.
Exclude EXPORT_PATH from safe read-only diagnostic plans because it can create files on the NX host.
No result-table shape can substitute for independently authenticated completed-analysis evidence.
Synthetic response shapes cannot establish provenance, result correctness, or engineering acceptance.
Reject unexpected envelope fields and output bounded reason codes rather than raw captures.
On incomplete evidence, fail closed; never automatically analyze, save, or mutate the model.
